resolution.question: During the first week of October 2012, will major national polling organizations publicly release at least three new head-to-head surveys on the Obama-Romney presidential race?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least three distinct major national polling organizations publicly released a head-to-head Obama-Romney survey between 2012-10-01T00:00:00-04:00 and 2012-10-08T21:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO.
